newsitem.title: ITALY: RUGBY UNION-ITALY TO FACE SPRINGBOKS IN ROME.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-ITALY TO FACE SPRINGBOKS IN ROME.

text.p: Italy will have the chance to press their bid for a place in the Five Nations' rugby union championship when they play world champions South Africa in Rome on November 8.
This season the Italians suffered narrow defeats at the hands of Wales and Scotland before beating Ireland and, most surprisingly, Grand Slam winners France.
They played against the Springboks in Rome in November 1995, losing 40-21.
After the South Africa match, Italy will host Ireland in December and Scotland in January. They then travel to Cardiff to play Wales in February.
